description: Rolls the run back to one of its ready checkpoints: each machine of the checkpoint boots again with its disks as they were, then the run's CURRENT machines are DELETED with everything written to them since. Confirm with the user first unless they asked for it. If any machine of the checkpoint does not come back, nothing changes. Restored machines have new addresses: read list_instances, then get_ssh_command. It runs in the background: call get_run until status is running again (restore_report says what came back and what was replaced). Data volumes that were attached to the replaced machines are kept, detached: the run's own stay in the run, any other stays the account's.

id.description: The run's id, from create_run or list_runs.

name: restore_run
title: Restore run to a checkpoint
